subject: RE: outreach bot
body: Spec: personalised cold emails to 200 leads (name, company). Fill {first name} and {company}. Max 50 a day, working unsubscribe link, never email an unsubscriber, no duplicates. And a Test button that sends the first 3 to me.

outcomes.when: the player offers or agrees to take the job: to build, make, create, do, help with or take on the outreach bot, in any wording ("happy to help", "I can do that", "count me in"); not a refusal or an unrelated question
outcomes.reply: Great. Helping me spam the world, one lead at a time.

hints: Offer to build the cold-email bot.
